description: Eight candidate cases improved via assistant checks of official sources October 22, but human source/case review is NOT established; all provenance flags false. Mocks test contracts, not factual accuracy.

cases.text: Earth is the third planet from the Sun.
cases.rationale_for_expected: NASA About the Planets explicitly identifies Earth as third from the Sun. Source-01 candidate; owner review pending.

cases.text: Pluto is classified as a full planet by the International Astronomical Union.
cases.rationale_for_expected: IAU Resolution 5A defines classes, Resolution 6A classifies Pluto as a dwarf planet, refuting full planet claim. Owner review pending.

cases.text: Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the Moon in 1969.
cases.rationale_for_expected: NASA Armstrong profile states he was the first to walk on the Moon on July 20, 1969, during Apollo 11. Owner review pending.

cases.text: The Great Wall of China is easily visible from space with the naked eye.
cases.rationale_for_expected: NASA JSC Earth Observations FAQ says Great Wall not visible to naked eye from orbit. Owner review pending.

cases.text: Everyone in the world has access to clean drinking water.
cases.rationale_for_expected: WHO says 2.2 billion people lacked safely managed drinking-water services in 2022, contradicting universal access. Owner review pending.

cases.text: The ocean contains most of Earth's water.
cases.rationale_for_expected: NOAA says about 97% of Earth's water is in oceans; directly supports literally true claim. Owner review pending.
No evidence supplied. Medical claim requires authoritative reviewed sources. Without evidence, only UNVERIFIABLE is valid per the grounding rule.

cases.text: A new species of deep-sea fish was discovered in the Mariana Trench in 2025.
cases.rationale_for_expected: No evidence supplied. Specific factual claim about a recent event requires sourced evidence. Without any supplied evidence, only UNVERIFIABLE is valid.
